title: Phase-Fidelity-Aware Truncated Quantum Fourier Transform for Scalable Phase Estimation on NISQ Hardware
summary: Quantum phase estimation~(QPE) is central to numerous quantum algorithms, yet its standard implementation demands an $\calO(m^{2})$-gate quantum Fourier transform~(QFT) on $m$ control qubits-a prohibitive overhead on near-term noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices. We introduce the \emph{Phase-Fidelity-Aware Truncated QFT} (PFA-TQFT), a family of approximate QFT circuits parameterised by a truncation depth~$d$ that omits controlled-phase rotations below a hardware-calibrated fidelity threshold~$\eps$.
